Package com.hkust.marketplace.models

Class LendingRules

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.models.LendingRules
public final class LendingRules extends Object
The one place the lending-duration and borrow-period rules live, so a Lend Listing and the deal lifecycle cannot disagree about what a valid duration is.

The minimum is five seconds so short loans can be exercised in tests and demos (SRS UC-1.4). Both methods return the value they validated, so callers assign the result instead of re-reading their argument.
